notes: Ammo Reserve cards now visualize progress toward each configured caliber target with percentage bars and exact rounds below/over target.
Reserve progress uses red/orange/yellow/green health states, with configured reorder thresholds overriding percentage health.
Manufacturer management now includes All / Firearms / Ammunition / Accessories filters plus manufacturer search.
No inventory schema changes and no destructive data migration.
Ammo inventory filter lists now include only calibers, manufacturers, and projectile types with positive on-hand quantity.
